contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesInto2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">70.8</ix:nonFraction> million of aggregate principal amount less $<ix:nonFraction id="c753" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesInto2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DeferredFinanceCostsNet" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.4</ix:nonFraction> million of issuance costs. Including the Equitization Transaction, this exchange results in a net $<ix:nonFraction id="c754" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesInto2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">3.0</ix:nonFraction> million loss on extinguishment which we recorded to our statement of operations and comprehensive loss. The Convertible Note Exchange was conducted with a limited number of holders of the 2026 Notes pursuant to exchange agreements dated May 12, 2025 (each, an “Exchange Agreement”).</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">The 2029 Notes were issued pursuant to an Indenture, dated as of August 14, 2020 (the “Base Indenture”), between the Company and Computershare Trust Company, National Association, as successor to Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as trustee (the “Trustee”), as supplemented by a Second Supplemental Indenture, dated as of May 14, 2025 (the “Second Supplemental Indenture”), between the Company and the Trustee (the Base Indenture, as amended and supplemented by the Second Supplemental Indenture, the “Indenture”). The 2029 Notes will mature on June 15, 2029 unless earlier converted, redeemed or repurchased in accordance with their terms prior to such date. </p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">Interest on the 2029 Notes is payable semi-annually in arrears at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c755" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">9.50</ix:nonFraction>% per annum on each June 15 and December 15, beginning on December 15, 2025. Due to the discount amortization on the 2029 Notes, interest expense is currently being recognized at an implied effective interest rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c756" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">1.82</ix:nonFraction>%. The 2029 Notes are convertible at the option of the holder into shares of common stock, cash or a combination thereof, as elected by us, at any time prior to the close of business on the second scheduled trading day immediately preceding the maturity date. The conversion rate is <ix:nonFraction id="c757" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionRatio1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">161.81</ix:nonFraction> shares of our common stock per $<ix:nonFraction id="c758" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleDebtDenominatorAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1,000</ix:nonFraction> of note principal (equivalent to an initial conversion price of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c759" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">6.18</ix:nonFraction> per share of common stock), which equals approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c760" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">11.5</ix:nonFraction> million shares issuable upon conversion, subject to adjustment in certain circumstances. The conversion rate is subject to adjustment in certain circumstances as described in the Indenture.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">Holders who convert their 2029 Notes from, and including, November 14, 2025 to, but excluding, June 1, 2029 (except for any conversion in connection with a make-whole fundamental change) will also be entitled to an interest make-whole payment equal to the sum of the remaining scheduled payments of interest that would have been made on the 2029 Notes to be converted had such notes remained outstanding from the conversion date through the earlier of (i) the date that is <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertiblePeriodAfterConversionDateForInterestPayment" id="c761" format="ixt-sec:durmonth">18</ix:nonNumeric> months following the conversion date and (ii) the maturity date. We recorded a $<ix:nonFraction id="c762" contextRef="i_2025-05-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-ConversionOptionDerivativeMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDerivativeNet" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6" sign="-">23.0</ix:nonFraction> million initial embedded derivative as a component of our 2029 Notes which represents the conversion feature available to holders of the 2029 Notes allowing them to convert the notes into common stock. At June 30, 2025, we marked-to-market the initial $<ix:nonFraction id="c763" contextRef="i_2025-05-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-ConversionOptionDerivativeMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDerivativeNet" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6" sign="-">23.0</ix:nonFraction> million embedded derivative on the 2029 Notes to $<ix:nonFraction id="c764" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-ConversionOptionDerivativeMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:EmbeddedDerivativeFairValueOfEmbeddedDerivativeNet" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6" sign="-">15.0</ix:nonFraction> million, recording an $<ix:nonFraction id="c765" contextRef="d_2025-05-15_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember_DerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis-ConversionOptionDerivativeMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">8.0</ix:nonFraction> million gain on remeasurement to our condensed consolidated statement of operations and comprehensive loss. The 2029 Notes include a $<ix:nonFraction id="c766" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">20.2</ix:nonFraction> million discount which we amortize as an addition to the carrying value and treat as non-cash interest expense in the condensed consolidated statement of operations and comprehensive loss over the duration of the term. </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">The 2029 Notes will be redeemable, in whole or in part, at our option at any time, and from time to time, on or after June 20, 2027 and on or before the <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleTradingDaysBeforeMaturity" id="c767" format="ixt-sec:durday">50</ix:nonNumeric>th scheduled trading day immediately before the maturity date, at a cash redemption price equal to the principal amount of the 2029 Notes to be redeemed, plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date, but only if the last reported sale price per share of our common stock exceeds <ix:nonFraction id="c768" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">130</ix:nonFraction>% of the conversion price on (i) each of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c769" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">20</ix:nonFraction> trading days, whether or not consecutive, during the <ix:nonFraction id="c770" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">30</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading days ending on, and including, the trading day immediately before the date we send the related redemption notice and (ii) the trading day immediately before the date we send such notice. In addition, calling any 2029 Note for redemption will constitute a “make-whole fundamental change” (as defined in the Indenture) with respect to that 2029 Note, in which case the conversion rate applicable to the conversion of that 2029 Note will be increased in certain circumstances if it is converted after it is called for redemption.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">The Indenture contains customary terms and covenants and events of default. If an event of default (other than certain events of bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization involving the Company) occurs and is continuing, the Trustee or the holders of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c771" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentDefaultDeclaredPayableInFullPercentageOfHoldersOfDebt" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">25</ix:nonFraction>% in aggregate principal amount of the 2029 Notes then outstanding may declare the principal amount of, and all accrued and unpaid interest on, all of the 2029 Notes then outstanding to become due and payable immediately. Upon the occurrence of certain events of bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization involving the Company, the principal amount of, and all accrued and unpaid interest, if any, on all of the 2029 Notes then outstanding will immediately become due and payable without any further action or notice by the Trustee or any holder. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Indenture provides that, to the extent we elect and for up to <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2029NotesMember" name="omer:DebtInstrumentDefaultSpecialInterestPeriod" id="c772" format="ixt-sec:durday">180</ix:nonNumeric> days, the sole remedy for an event of default relating to certain failures by us to comply with certain reporting covenants in the Indenture may consist exclusively of the right to receive special interest on the 2029 Notes.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">The 2029 Notes are structurally subordinated to all existing and future indebtedness and other liabilities, including trade payables, and (to the extent we are not a holder thereof) preferred equity, if any, of its subsidiaries.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"><i>Equitization Transaction</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">On May 12, 2025, we entered into Note Conversion Agreements with two affiliated holders of the 2026 Notes to convert $<ix:nonFraction id="c773" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of the 2026 Notes into shares of our common stock. Under the terms of the Note Conversion Agreements, the holders agreed to convert the equitized principal amount of the 2026 Notes in three tranches for a number of shares of common stock to be determined based in part on the closing price of our common stock on May 9, 2025 and in part based on the <ix:nonFraction id="c774" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">20</ix:nonFraction>-day volume-weighted average price applicable to each tranche conversion date, subject to a floor conversion price. The Note Conversion Agreements provide that the final settlement will occur no later than September 15, 2025. As of June 30, 2025, we delivered <ix:nonFraction id="c775" contextRef="d_2025-06-30_2025-06-30_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">539,320</ix:nonFraction> shares of the first tranche under this agreement with the remaining shares for the first tranche delivered on July 15, 2025. As of June 30, 2025, we have recorded a $<ix:nonFraction id="c776" contextRef="i_2025-06-30" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmountCurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">7.6</ix:nonFraction> million share-settled liability in our condensed consolidated balance sheet representing the remaining liability owed to the two affiliated holders under the Note Conversion Agreements. We subsequently delivered an aggregate of <ix:nonFraction id="c777" contextRef="d_2025-07-01_2025-08-11_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">1,996,555</ix:nonFraction> additional shares in connection with the completion of the settlement for the first tranche, the settlement of the second tranche and the partial settlement of the third tranche. The Note Conversion Agreements provide that the final settlement will occur no later than September 15, 2025. </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">The Convertible Note Exchange transaction and Equitization Transaction reduced the aggregate principal balance of our 2026 Notes from $<ix:nonFraction id="c778" contextRef="i_2025-05-13_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">97.9</ix:nonFraction> million to $<ix:nonFraction id="c779" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">17.1</ix:nonFraction> million. The $<ix:nonFraction id="c780" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoCommonStockAnd2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">80.8</ix:nonFraction> million reduction in aggregate principal amount of our 2026 Notes reflects the exchange of $<ix:nonFraction id="c781" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesInto2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">70.8</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of 2026 Notes for 2029 Notes under the Convertible Note Exchange and the reduction of $<ix:nonFraction id="c782" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million in aggregate principal amount to be equitized under the Note Conversion Agreements. Because we have a contractual obligation to cancel $<ix:nonFraction id="c783" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of 2026 Notes pursuant to the Note Conversion Agreements, we recognize the full reduction of the $<ix:nonFraction id="c784" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million at June 30, 2025 from the 2026 Notes balance. Accordingly, the Equitization Transaction resulted in us initially recording a share-settled liability. As of June 30, 2025, we cancelled $<ix:nonFraction id="c785" contextRef="d_2025-05-15_2025-06-30" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:FinancialInstrumentMandatorilyRedeemableLiabilityClassifiedSettlementAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">3.3</ix:nonFraction> million of this liability, reflecting equitization of the first tranche under the Note Conversion Agreements.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -18pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"><b><i>2024 Secured Term Loan </i></b></p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">On June 3, 2024, we entered into a Credit Agreement with the Lenders, pursuant to which we have an outstanding Term Loan of $<ix:nonFraction id="c794" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-InitialTermLoanMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">67.1</ix:nonFraction> million. The Credit Agreement provides that, at any time prior to November 1, 2025, the Company, at its sole discretion, may exchange up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c795" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertiblePrincipalAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">14.9</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of outstanding 2026 Notes for cash and/or additional Term Loan amounts, with the holders of such notes becoming Lenders under the Credit Agreement. As of August 14, 2025, no such additional exchanges for additional Term Loans have occurred. All indebtedness under the Credit Agreement is secured by a first-priority security interest in and lien on substantially all our tangible and intangible property, subject to customary exceptions, and excluding royalty interests in OMIDRIA and certain related rights.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">In connection with our entry into the Credit Agreement, we used the Term Loan proceeds along with $<ix:nonFraction id="c796" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtRestructuringCosts" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">21.7</ix:nonFraction> million of cash on hand to repurchase $<ix:nonFraction id="c797" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">118.1</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of the 2026 Notes held by the Lenders. The total consideration paid at closing of $<ix:nonFraction id="c798" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">88.8</ix:nonFraction> million represented a purchase price equal to approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c799" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentageOfPrincipalAmountRedeemed" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">75</ix:nonFraction>% of the par value of the 2026 Notes retired in the transaction. The reduction in the aggregate outstanding principal balance of our 2026 Notes and incurrence of a new Term Loan resulted in a $<ix:nonFraction id="c800" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentIncreaseDecreaseForPeriodNet" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6" sign="-">51.0</ix:nonFraction> million reduction of our outstanding debt. The $<ix:nonFraction id="c801" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedPremium" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">29.3</ix:nonFraction> million difference between the $<ix:nonFraction id="c802" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">118.1</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of the 2026 Notes and the $<ix:nonFraction id="c803" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">88.8</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate repurchase price was recorded as a premium (i.e., an increase) to the long-term debt on the Company’s condensed consolidated balance sheet instead of being recognized as a gain on early extinguishment of debt. The premium is being amortized as both a non-cash reduction of long-term debt in the condensed consolidated balance sheets and interest expense in the condensed consolidated statement of operations and comprehensive loss over the duration of the Term Loan. </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">The Term Loan has a stated maturity date of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate" id="c812" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en">June 3, 2028</ix:nonNumeric> and bears interest at an adjusted <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c813">secured overnight financing rate</span> (“adjusted SOFR”), subject to a <ix:nonFraction id="c814" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentFloorOnVariableRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">3.00</ix:nonFraction>% floor, plus <ix:nonFraction id="c815" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">8.75</ix:nonFraction>% per annum, payable quarterly from the Closing Date. As of June 30, 2025, the contractual interest rate on the Term Loan was <ix:nonFraction id="c816" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">13.17</ix:nonFraction>%. We have the option to pay all of the interest in cash or to pay <ix:nonFraction id="c817" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPercentageOfInterestPayableInCash" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">50</ix:nonFraction>% in cash and pay-in-kind (“PIK”), the remaining interest. When this provision is elected, interest for the quarter, including both the cash interest and PIK interest, is calculated based on adjusted SOFR plus a <ix:nonFraction id="c818" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPaidInKindBasisSpreadOnVariableRate" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">10.25</ix:nonFraction>% PIK margin (instead of the customary <ix:nonFraction id="c819" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">8.75</ix:nonFraction>% margin). The PIK interest is then added to the outstanding principal balance and interest is computed using the original adjusted SOFR plus <ix:nonFraction id="c820" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">8.75</ix:nonFraction>% margin rate. Due to the premium amortization on the Term Loan, interest expense is currently being recognized at an implied effective interest rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c821" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">3.44</ix:nonFraction>%.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">We may elect to prepay the Term Loan, in whole or in part, in cash, plus an applicable prepayment and/or make-whole premium. Under certain circumstances, we are required to prepay all or a portion of the outstanding Loans, plus an applicable prepayment and/or make-whole premium, as described below. </p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 44pt;text-indent:-18pt;">(1)   If, on November 1, 2025, (i) the aggregate outstanding principal amount of the outstanding 2026 Notes that is not held by the Lenders equals or exceeds $<ix:nonFraction id="c834" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantMinimumPrincipalAmountRequiredToTriggerPrepayment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">38.5</ix:nonFraction> million and (ii) we have not made or delivered notice that we expect to make certain voluntary or mandatory prepayments under the Credit Agreement of at least $<ix:nonFraction id="c835" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantMandatoryPrepayment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million in the aggregate, then we would be required, on or prior to November 15, 2025, to make a $<ix:nonFraction id="c836" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantMandatoryPrepayment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million mandatory prepayment, together with a $<ix:nonFraction id="c837" contextRef="i_2025-11-01_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantPrepaymentPremium" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">1.0</ix:nonFraction> million prepayment premium to avoid accelerated maturity of the entire Term Loan balance. As a result of the Convertible Note Exchange completed on May 14, 2025, the prepayment requirement is no longer applicable because the outstanding principal amount under the 2026 Notes was reduced below $<ix:nonFraction id="c838" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantMinimumPrincipalAmountRequiredToTriggerPrepayment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">38.5</ix:nonFraction> million. As a result, the accompanying condensed consolidated balance sheet as of June 30, 2025 reflects the entire Term Loan as a long-term liability.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 44pt;text-indent:-18pt;">(2)   Upon the occurrence of a change in control, we must prepay the entire outstanding amount of the Term Loan, plus the applicable make-whole or prepayment premium.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 44pt;text-indent:-18pt;">(3)   We must prepay the outstanding Term Loan in an amount equal to: (i) <ix:nonFraction id="c839" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfMilestonePaymentsReceived" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">25.0</ix:nonFraction>% of any milestone payments received from DRI or its affiliates on the basis of net sales of OMIDRIA; (ii) <ix:nonFraction id="c840" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfCashProceedsFromSaleOrLicenseOfAssets" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">60.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds (excluding transaction expenses and certain milestone payments) received by Omeros from the sale or license of our assets; (iii) <ix:nonFraction id="c841" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfCashProceedsFromIndebtedness" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100.0</ix:nonFraction>% of net cash proceeds of indebtedness incurred by the Company other than as permitted by the Credit Agreement; and (iv) <ix:nonFraction id="c842" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentPercentageOfNetCashProceedsFromInsuranceRecoveries" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds of insurance recoveries on loss of property, except to the extent utilized to repair or replace the relevant assets within a specified time.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">Voluntary and mandatory prepayments of the Term Loan are subject to payment of the following premiums: (i) during the first year of such amounts are outstanding under the Term Loan, a make-whole premium plus <ix:nonFraction id="c843" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentsAnnualPrepaymentPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">5.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the applicable prepayment amount (unless the prepayment is made in contemplation of a change of control, in which case only the make-whole premium would be payable); (ii) during the second year, a prepayment premium equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c844" contextRef="i_2025-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentsAnnualPrepaymentPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">5.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the applicable prepayment amount; and (iii) during the third year, a prepayment premium equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c845" contextRef="i_2026-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_StatementScenarioAxis-ScenarioForecastMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentPrepaymentsAnnualPrepaymentPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">3.0</ix:nonFraction>% of the applicable prepayment amount. </p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">The Credit Agreement contains certain customary default provisions, representations and warranties and affirmative and negative covenants. These include a covenant requiring us to maintain at all times unrestricted cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of at least $<ix:nonFraction id="c846" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantRequiredUnrestrictedCash" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">25.0</ix:nonFraction> million in accounts subject to control agreements and a covenant limiting the use of cash for open market or privately negotiated repurchases of any outstanding 2026 Notes to: (i) an initial amount not exceeding $<ix:nonFraction id="c847" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantOpenMarketTransactionsMaximumAmountOfInitialCash" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">25.0</ix:nonFraction> million, which may be increased by up to an additional $<ix:nonFraction id="c848" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantOpenMarketTransactionsConditionalAdditionalAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions; (ii) an unlimited amount, if the amount of the outstanding Term Loan at the time of repurchase does not exceed $<ix:nonFraction id="c849" name="omer:DebtInstrumentCovenantOpenMarketTransactionsMaximumAdditionalAmountPercentageOfProceedsFromEquityOffering" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">50</ix:nonFraction>% of the net cash proceeds from an equity offering, provided that the Company offers to prepay an equal amount of the Term Loan with the net cash proceeds of such offering. As of June 30, 2025 and through the date of issuance of these condensed consolidated financial statements, the Company was in compliance with the covenants under the Credit Agreement. A default under the Credit Agreement that results in the outstanding debt thereunder being declared due and payable prior to the stated maturity would constitute a cross-default under the indenture governing the 2026 Notes or the 2029 Notes, as applicable. In such an event, the principal and all accrued and unpaid interest on the 2026 Notes and the 2029 Notes may be declared immediately due and payable either by the trustee under the applicable indenture, or by holders of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c851" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentDefaultDeclaredPayableInFullPercentageOfHoldersOfDebt" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">25</ix:nonFraction>% of the aggregate outstanding principal amounts of the 2026 Notes and the 2029 Notes, respectively.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">The fair value of the Term Loan is classified as a Level 3 liability. As of June 30, 2025 and December 31, 2024, the approximate fair value of our Term Loan obligations was $<ix:nonFraction id="c852" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LongTermDebtFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">69.9</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c853" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:LongTermDebtFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">69.5</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively. We determined the fair market value by discounting the future cash flows based on adjusted SOFR at each measurement date.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman"; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i>2026 Unsecured Convertible Senior Notes </i></b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We have outstanding unsecured convertible senior notes which accrue interest at an annual rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c854" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">5.25</ix:nonFraction>% per annum, payable semi-annually in arrears on February 15 and August 15 of each year. The 2026 Notes mature on February 15, 2026, unless earlier purchased, redeemed or converted in accordance with their terms.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">In 2024, we repurchased $<ix:nonFraction id="c855" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">118.1</ix:nonFraction> million of principal amount outstanding on our 2026 Notes for total consideration of $<ix:nonFraction id="c856" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">88.8</ix:nonFraction> million (approximately<span style="color:#000000;"> <ix:nonFraction id="c857" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentageOfPrincipalAmountRedeemed" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">75</ix:nonFraction>% of par value)</span>, using proceeds from the Term Loan of $<ix:nonFraction id="c858" contextRef="i_2024-06-03_DebtInstrumentAxis-TheCreditAndGuarantyAgreementMember_LongtermDebtTypeAxis-InitialTermLoanMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">67.1</ix:nonFraction> million and paying $<ix:nonFraction id="c859" contextRef="d_2024-06-03_2024-06-03_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2026NotesIntoNewTermLoansMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtRestructuringCosts" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">21.7</ix:nonFraction> million of cash on hand. </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">On May 14, 2025, we completed the Convertible Note Exchange in which we exchanged $<ix:nonFraction id="c860" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesInto2029NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">70.8</ix:nonFraction> million in aggregate principal of our 2026 Notes for a like principal amount of our 2029 Notes. On May 12, 2025, we entered into the Equitization Transaction, which resulted in the conversion of an additional $<ix:nonFraction id="c861" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of 2026 Notes into shares of our common stock, to be delivered in three approximately equal tranches on or prior to September 15, 2025. As of June 30, 2025, we recorded a $<ix:nonFraction id="c862" contextRef="i_2025-06-30" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmountCurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">7.6</ix:nonFraction> million share-settled liability reflecting the unsettled shares still to be issued. The principal balance of our 2026 Notes was reduced from $<ix:nonFraction id="c863" contextRef="i_2025-05-13_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">97.9</ix:nonFraction> million to $<ix:nonFraction id="c864" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">17.1</ix:nonFraction> million as a result of the Convertible Note Exchange and Equitization Transaction. </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Amounts outstanding on our 2026 Notes as of June 30, 2025 and December 31, 2024 are as follows:</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> ​</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">The conversion rate is <ix:nonFraction id="c892" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionRatio1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">54.0906</ix:nonFraction> shares of our common stock per $<ix:nonFraction id="c893" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleDebtDenominatorAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1,000</ix:nonFraction> of note principal (equivalent to an initial conversion price of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c894" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">18.4875</ix:nonFraction> per share of common stock), which equals approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c895" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.3</ix:nonFraction> million shares issuable upon conversion, subject to adjustment in certain circumstances.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">The 2026 Notes are convertible at the option of the holders on or after November 15, 2025 at any time prior to the close of business on February 12, 2026, the second scheduled trading day immediately before the stated maturity date of <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate" id="c896" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en">February 15, 2026</ix:nonNumeric>. Additionally, holders may convert their 2026 Notes at their option at specified times prior to the maturity date only if:</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 71pt;text-indent:-18pt;">(1)   during any calendar quarter, the last reported sale price per share of our common stock exceeds <ix:nonFraction id="c897" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionAfterSeptember302020Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">130</ix:nonFraction>% of the conversion price of the 2026 Notes for each of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c898" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">20</ix:nonFraction> trading days, whether or not consecutive, in the period of <ix:nonFraction id="c899" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">30</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading days ending on, and including, the last trading day of the immediately preceding calendar quarter;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 71pt;text-indent:-18pt;">(2)   during the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c900">five</span> consecutive business days immediately after any <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c901">five</span>-consecutive-trading-day period (such <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c902">five</span>-consecutive-trading-day period, the “measurement period”) in which the trading price per $<ix:nonFraction id="c903" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionAfterSeptember302020Member" unitRef="USD" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleDebtDenominatorAmount" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">1,000</ix:nonFraction> principal amount of 2026 Notes for each trading day of the measurement period was less than <ix:nonFraction id="c904" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionAfterSeptember302020Member" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdSalePriceOfCommonStockConversionRateProductPercentageMaximum" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">98</ix:nonFraction>% of the product of the last reported sale price per share of our common stock on such trading day and the conversion rate on such trading day;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 80pt;text-indent:-27pt;">(3)   there is an occurrence of one or more certain corporate events or distributions of our common stock; or</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 80pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -27pt;">(4)   we call the 2026 Notes for redemption.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 80pt; text-align: left; text-indent: -27pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">We will settle any conversions by paying or delivering, as applicable, cash, shares of our common stock or a combination of cash and shares of our common stock, at our election, based on the applicable conversion rate(s).</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">Subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions, we may redeem in whole or in part the 2026 Notes at our option through the <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" name="omer:DebtInstrumentConvertibleTradingDaysBeforeMaturity" id="c905" format="ixt-sec:durday">50</ix:nonNumeric>th scheduled trading day immediately before the maturity date at a cash redemption price equal to the principal amount of the 2026 Notes to be redeemed plus any accrued and unpaid interest. The 2026 Notes are subject to redemption only if certain requirements are satisfied, including that the last reported sale price per share of our common stock exceeds <ix:nonFraction id="c906" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdPercentageOfStockPriceTrigger" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="1">130</ix:nonFraction>% of the conversion price on (i) each of at least <ix:nonFraction id="c907" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">20</ix:nonFraction> trading days, whether or not consecutive, during the <ix:nonFraction id="c908" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_StatementScenarioAxis-DebtConversionOnOrAfterAugust152023Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">30</ix:nonFraction> consecutive trading days ending on, and including, the trading day immediately before the date we send the related redemption notice and (ii) the trading day immediately before the date we send such notice.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">In order to reduce the dilutive impact or potential cash expenditure associated with the conversion of the 2026 Notes, we entered into capped call transactions in connection with the issuances of the 2026 Notes (the “2026 Capped Call”). The 2026 Capped Call will cover, subject to anti-dilution adjustments substantially similar to those applicable to the 2026 Notes, the number of shares of common stock underlying the 2026 Notes when our common stock is trading within the range of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c909" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">18.49</ix:nonFraction> and $<ix:nonFraction id="c910" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">26.10</ix:nonFraction>. However, should the market price of our common stock exceed the $<ix:nonFraction id="c911" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">26.10</ix:nonFraction> cap, then the conversion of the 2026 Notes would have an additional dilutive impact or may require a cash expenditure to the extent the market price of our common stock exceeds the cap price. The 2026 Capped Call will expire on various dates over the <ix:nonFraction id="c912" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">50</ix:nonFraction>-trading-day period ranging from December 2, 2025 to February 12, 2026, if not exercised earlier. The 2026 Capped Call is a separate transaction and not part of the terms of the 2026 Notes and was executed separately from the issuance of the 2026 Notes. The amount paid for the 2026 Capped Call was recorded as a reduction to additional paid-in capital in the condensed consolidated balance sheet. As of June 30, 2025, approximately <ix:nonFraction id="c913" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026CappedCallMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">12.2</ix:nonFraction> million shares remained outstanding under the 2026 Capped Call. We also retain all potential future value of the capped call purchased in connection with the issuance of the 2026 Notes covering all shares underlying the original 2026 Notes. </p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">Further, we concluded the 2026 Capped Call qualifies for a derivative scope exception for instruments that are both indexed to an entity’s own stock and classified in stockholders’ equity in its balance sheet. <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>7</b>—<b>Discontinued Operations - Sale of OMIDRIA</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>8</b>—<b>OMIDRIA Royalty Obligation </b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">In September 2022, we sold to DRI an interest in our future OMIDRIA royalty receipts and received $<ix:nonFraction id="c1133" contextRef="d_2022-09-30_2022-09-30_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:ProceedsFromRoyaltyObligation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">125.0</ix:nonFraction> million in cash consideration, which was recorded as an OMIDRIA royalty obligation on our condensed consolidated balance sheet. DRI was entitled to receive royalties on OMIDRIA net sales between September 1, 2022 and December 31, 2030, subject to annual caps.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">In February 2024, Omeros and DRI expanded their royalty purchase agreement under the Amendment, resulting in the elimination of previously existing annual caps on royalty payments and Omeros receiving an additional $<ix:nonFraction id="c1134" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:ProceedsFromRoyaltyObligation" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">115.5</ix:nonFraction> million in cash consideration, which we accounted for as a modification of our existing debt from DRI. All royalties earned on OMIDRIA sales within the U.S. through December 31, 2031 are remitted by Rayner to an escrow account established by Omeros, from which payments are made to DRI. </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We retain the right to receive all royalties payable by Rayner on any U.S. net sales of OMIDRIA after December 31, 2031 and on all royalties on global net sales of OMIDRIA payable from and after December 31, 2031. To date, international royalties have not been significant. DRI has no recourse to our assets other than its interest in OMIDRIA royalties.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We are also entitled to receive a milestone payment ranging between $<ix:nonFraction id="c1135" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkOneIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1136" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkOneIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">27.5</ix:nonFraction> million if U.S. net sales of OMIDRIA reach applicable thresholds ranging between a total of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1137" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkOneMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">156.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1138" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkOneMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">160.0</ix:nonFraction> million in the aggregate for any period of four consecutive quarters prior to January 1, 2026. We do not expect to receive this milestone payment. In addition, we are entitled to receive a separate milestone payment ranging between $<ix:nonFraction id="c1139" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkTwoIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">8.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1140" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkTwoIfMilestoneAchieves" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">27.5</ix:nonFraction> million if U.S. net sales of OMIDRIA reach applicable thresholds ranging between a total of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1141" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkTwoMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">181.0</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1142" contextRef="d_2024-02-01_2024-02-29_RangeAxis-MaximumMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:MilestoneBenchmarkTwoMinimumNetSalesRequiredForFourConsecutiveQuarters" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">185.0</ix:nonFraction> million in the aggregate for any period of four consecutive quarters prior to January 1, 2028.</p>

The fair value of the OMIDRIA royalty obligation is determined by calculating the net present value of our estimated future OMIDRIA cash flows using the interest rate at inception of our royalty purchase agreement with DRI, adjusted for the change in the prime rate through the measurement date. As of June 30, 2025 and December 31, 2024, the approximate fair value of our obligation was $<ix:nonFraction id="c1147" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:RoyaltyObligationFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">191.9</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c1148" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_CounterpartyNameAxis-DRIHealthcareAcquisitionLpMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:RoyaltyObligationFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">209.7</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively<span style="color:#cc0000;">.</span></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>9</b>—<b>Lease Liabilities</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We have an operating lease for our office and laboratory facilities with an initial term that ends in November 2027 and <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1222">two</span> options to extend the lease term by an additional <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c1223">five</span> years each. Restricted investments of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1224" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_LeaseContractualTermAxis-OfficeAndLaboratoryFacilitiesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.1</ix:nonFraction> million represent the security deposit on our office and laboratory facilities. <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>10</b>—<b>Commitments and Contingencies</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 9pt;"><i>Good and Service Contracts </i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We have various agreements with third parties that collectively require payment of termination fees totaling $<ix:nonFraction id="c1287" contextRef="i_2025-06-30" unitRef="USD" name="omer:LongtermPurchaseCommitmentTerminationFee" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">3.9</ix:nonFraction> million as of June 30, 2025 if we cancel the work within specific time frames, either prior to commencing or during performance of the contracted services.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 9pt;"><i>Development Milestones and Product Royalties </i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">We have entered a variety of development, collaboration, licensing or similar agreements with third parties under which we have accessed technology or services in connection with our development assets and programs. Some of these agreements require milestone payments based on achievements of development, regulatory or sales milestones, and/or low-single to low-double digit royalties on net income or net sales of the relevant product. For the three and six months ended June 30, 2025 and 2024, development milestone expenses were not significant. </p>
</ix:nonNumeric>

<div> </div>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30" name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityNoteDisclosureTextBlock" id="c1288" escape="true">
<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b> <b>11</b>—<b>Shareholders</b>’<b> Deficit </b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 9pt;"><i>Common Stock </i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">At-the-Market Sales Agreement</span> - We have a sales agreement to sell shares of our common stock having an aggregate offering price of up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c1290" contextRef="i_2021-03-01_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-AtTheMarketEquityOfferingProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="omer:EquityOfferingFacilityMaximumAggregateOfferingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">150.0</ix:nonFraction> million, from time to time, through an ATM equity offering program. During the six months ended June 30, 2025, we sold<ix:nonFraction id="c1291" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-AtTheMarketEquityOfferingProgramMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.4</ix:nonFraction> million shares of common stock pursuant to our ATM program, generating net proceeds of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1292" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-06-30_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-AtTheMarketEquityOfferingProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">6.4</ix:nonFraction> million at an average price per share of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1293" contextRef="i_2025-06-30_RangeAxis-WeightedAverageMember_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-AtTheMarketEquityOfferingProgramMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">4.55</ix:nonFraction>. Subsequent to June 30, 2025, we sold <ix:nonFraction id="c1294" contextRef="d_2025-07-01_2025-08-14_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-AtTheMarketEquityOfferingProgramMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.7</ix:nonFraction> million shares of common stock, generating net proceeds of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1295" contextRef="d_2025-07-01_2025-08-14_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-AtTheMarketEquityOfferingProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">2.1</ix:nonFraction> million at an average price per share of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1296" contextRef="i_2025-08-14_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-AtTheMarketEquityOfferingProgramMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3.14</ix:nonFraction>.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Share Repurchase Program</span> - On November 9, 2023, the Board of Directors approved a share repurchase program under which we were permitted to repurchase from time to time up to $<ix:nonFraction id="c1297" contextRef="i_2023-11-09_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="srt:StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">50.0</ix:nonFraction> million of our common stock in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions. During the six months ended June 30, 2024, we repurchased and retired <ix:nonFraction id="c1298" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-06-30_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodShares" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">3.2</ix:nonFraction> million shares of common stock for an average price per share of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1299" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-06-30_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="omer:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredAveragePricePerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">3.71</ix:nonFraction> at an aggregate cost of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1300" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-06-30_ShareRepurchaseProgramAxis-IndefiniteTermShareRepurchaseProgramMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">11.9</ix:nonFraction> million. The terms of the Credit Agreement prohibit us from repurchasing our common stock unless expressly agreed to by the Lenders. Consequently, the Board of Directors terminated the share repurchase program effective upon the execution of the Credit Agreement.</p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Equitization Transaction</span> - On May 12, 2025, we entered into the Note Conversion Agreements with two affiliated holders of the 2026 Notes to convert $<ix:nonFraction id="c1301" contextRef="d_2025-05-12_2025-05-12_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">10.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal amount of 2026 Notes into shares of our common stock to be delivered in three approximately equal tranches. As of June 30, 2025, we delivered <ix:nonFraction id="c1302" contextRef="d_2025-05-13_2025-06-30_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOfThe2026NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">539,320</ix:nonFraction> shares of the first tranche under this agreement and recorded a $<ix:nonFraction id="c1303" contextRef="i_2025-06-30" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettlementTermsAmountCurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">7.6</ix:nonFraction> million share-settled liability in our condensed consolidated balance sheet representing the remaining liability owed to the two affiliate holders. (For further details, see “Note 6 – Debt”). </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: left; text-indent: 18pt;">With respect to final settlement of Tranche 3, we will issue a number of shares to be determined based on the <ix:nonFraction id="c1313" contextRef="d_2025-05-14_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdTradingDays" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">20</ix:nonFraction>-day VWAP applicable at the final settlement date (subject to a floor conversion price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1314" contextRef="i_2025-05-14_DebtInstrumentAxis-ConvertibleSeniorNotes2026Member_RangeAxis-MinimumMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">2.50</ix:nonFraction>), less the initial settled shares listed above. The Note Conversion Agreements provide that the final settlement with respect to Tranche 3 will occur no later than September 15, 2025. (For further details refer to “Note 6 – Debt”).</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"> </p>

<p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;"><span style="text-decoration: underline; ">Registered Direct Offering</span> - On July 28, 2025, we issued and sold to Polar <ix:nonFraction id="c1315" contextRef="d_2025-07-28_2025-07-28_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-SecuritiesPurchaseAgreementWithPolarAssetManagementMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">5,365,853</ix:nonFraction> shares of our common stock at a price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c1316" contextRef="i_2025-07-28_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-SecuritiesPurchaseAgreementWithPolarAssetManagementMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:SharesIssuedPricePerShare" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">4.10</ix:nonFraction> per share, representing a <ix:nonFraction id="c1317" contextRef="i_2025-07-28_SubsequentEventTypeAxis-SubsequentEventMember_SubsidiarySaleOfStockAxis-SecuritiesPurchaseAgreementWithPolarAssetManagementMember" unitRef="Pure" name="omer:SharesIssuedPremiumOverStockPricePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">14</ix:nonFraction>% premium to the closing OMER stock price on the day of pricing, in a registered direct offering. <p style="font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: left;">Expected volatility is based on the historical volatility of our stock price weighted by grant issuances over the reporting period. We estimated the expected life of the stock options granted using the historical exercise behavior of option holders. The risk-free interest rate is based on the U.S. Treasury yield curve in effect at the time of grant. Forfeiture expense is estimated at the time of grant and revised in subsequent periods if actual forfeitures differ from those estimates.</p>
